description: A severed coil of violet muscle, suckers still gripping at nothing. Voidmaw has more where this came from.
lore: Cut off, it works for most of a day: grip, slacken, grip, tightening on cloth, on a strap, on whatever else is in the bag. So it travels wrapped alone, and it gets checked before wrapping, because whatever the arm last lay on comes away held in the rings — grit, chips of black rock, a splinter off somebody's crate.

One came over the counter at the fen market with a reed in the third sucker. Reeds do not grow within two days of the black rock. Either the animal went down into the wet country and came back, which nobody who works that ground will hear, or the ground itself has been somewhere else lately, which is the answer [[characters/a6d7323d|Gunnar]] gives when he gives one at all. The reed is in a box at that market. People are shown it, and then the market gets on with the afternoon.
gm_notes: A Drift proof hiding in a junk sucker. Keep both explanations bad and neither settled; the trade's response to an impossible fact is to display it and carry on selling.
